requirements.text: WHEN the user selects a process from any position in the process table, the system shall show that process detail within the current viewport without requiring a scroll to the end of the table.
WHEN process detail is open and the user activates Close, presses Escape, or activates the backdrop, the system shall dismiss the detail and return to the process explorer.
The process detail shall expose an accessible dialog name, modal semantics, visible focus, and a layout usable in narrow application windows.

scenarios.title: Selected process detail opens in the current viewport
scenarios.given: Given a process table longer than the current viewport
scenarios.when: When the user selects a visible process row
scenarios.then: Then an accessible modal dialog immediately shows that process detail without scrolling to the table end

scenarios.title: Process detail can be dismissed
scenarios.given: Given a process detail dialog is open
scenarios.when: When the user activates Close, presses Escape, or activates the backdrop
scenarios.then: Then the dialog closes and the process explorer remains available

obligations.title: Present and dismiss selected process detail as an accessible viewport modal

testPlans.title: Process detail modal visibility and dismissal

tasks.title: Move process detail into accessible viewport dialog
